integrity: The two-mode state classification is proved by explicit parity-sector matchgate constructions for arbitrary pure states and spectral decomposition for mixed states. The contradiction uses the source's own \(\eta(\mathrm{SWAP})=1\) and concurrence formula at \(p=0\). The packaged checker is corroborative; no independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The result corrects the interpretation of the written local channel definition. It does not dispute the four-mode Choi concurrence algebra and does not rule out the same numerical threshold for a separately defined ancilla-sensitive or completely resource-nongenerating channel notion.
title: The stated two-mode convex-Gaussian channel property is vacuous
